architecture.public_site_control: No exchange, custody, remittance, funds transmission, crowdfunding, payment processing, staking, lending or customer funds
architecture.residual_action: FINTRAC and payments analysis before enabling any such function

architecture.public_site_control: No checkout, consumer purchase, payment or online binding service contract
architecture.residual_action: Consumer-law review before selling to consumers or concluding distance contracts

architecture.public_site_control: No analytics, account, newsletter or server-side mission form; browser-local tools; privacy officer published
architecture.residual_action: PIA, deployment notice and contracts before private data processing

architecture.public_site_control: French and English legal surfaces; French Terms presented first in English gate
architecture.residual_action: Québec counsel/OQLF review for final commercial parity and contractual language process

architecture.public_site_control: AI-assisted artwork disclosure; no hidden chatbot; candidate-output boundary
architecture.residual_action: Deployment-specific AI Act and sector review before interactive AI in the EU or regulated use

architecture.public_site_control: Evidence taxonomy, status ledger, modeled-value disclaimer and visual disclosure
architecture.residual_action: Evidence owner approval for each material performance or customer claim
